title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct Jefferson library study environments across the Center City and East Falls campuses, with access and setup details verified from current university library pages.

cards.title: Scott Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Scott Memorial Library · Center City
cards.notes: Settle into the first-floor Reading Room for a library-based work session; bring your Jefferson ID and follow building access procedures.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor reading environment in Scott Memorial Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson’s study-space guide identifies a Reading Room on the first floor of Scott Memorial Library.
cards.access_notes: Center City open study-space users must show a Jefferson ID and may be asked to sign in and out at Security.

cards.title: Scott’s Collaboration Rooms
cards.subtitle: Scott Memorial Library · Center City
cards.notes: Reserve or use a second-floor group room when working with classmates; the rooms provide a computer, monitor, writing surface, and connection cables.
cards.short_summary: Small-group rooms equipped for shared screen work and whiteboard planning.
cards.evidence_claim: Scott Memorial Library has ten second-floor small-group collaboration rooms with computers, large monitors, writing surfaces, and laptop/iPad cables.
cards.access_notes: Six west-side rooms are unlocked 8am–2am; four east-side rooms may be reserved. Jefferson ID requirements apply.

cards.title: Scott’s Casual Reading Area
cards.subtitle: Scott Memorial Library · Center City
cards.notes: Use the named second-floor Casual Reading Area when you want an informal library setting; keep personal items with you and clear your workspace afterward.
cards.short_summary: An identified casual study setting on Scott Library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson’s study-space guide identifies a Casual Reading Area on the second floor of Scott Memorial Library.
cards.access_notes: Center City open study-space users must show a Jefferson ID and may be asked to sign in and out at Security.

cards.title: Scott’s Group Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Scott Memorial Library · Center City
cards.notes: Meet at the second-floor group tables for a collaborative session without booking a room; use the library’s nearby group-study area responsibly.
cards.short_summary: Named tables in Scott Library’s second-floor group-study zone.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson’s study-space guide identifies Group Study Tables on the second floor of Scott Memorial Library.
cards.access_notes: The second floor includes group options including carrels, tables, and study rooms; Jefferson ID requirements apply.

cards.title: Scott Third-Floor Carrels
cards.subtitle: Scott Memorial Library · Center City
cards.notes: Choose a third-floor carrel for quiet individual work; this floor is designated for quiet study and has carrels, pods, and tables.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-floor carrel option for focused library work.
cards.evidence_claim: The third floor of Scott Memorial Library provides carrels, pods, and tables for quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Quiet study is on Scott’s third and fourth floors; Center City open-space users must show Jefferson ID.

cards.title: Scott Fourth-Floor Carrels
cards.subtitle: Scott Memorial Library · Center City
cards.notes: Head to the fourth-floor carrels when your work calls for a quiet setup; observe the floor’s quiet-study designation while you are there.
cards.short_summary: A separate quiet-floor carrel setting in Scott Memorial Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson’s study-space guide identifies Study Carrels on the fourth floor and says the fourth floor provides quiet-study carrels, pods, and tables.
cards.access_notes: Quiet study is on Scott’s third and fourth floors; Center City open-space users must show Jefferson ID.

cards.title: Gutman Room 101
cards.subtitle: Paul J. Gutman Library · East Falls
cards.notes: Book Room 101 for a larger project meeting or presentation practice; it seats six to eight and includes a plasma screen for computer projection.
cards.short_summary: A reservable, larger-capacity group room with projection.
cards.evidence_claim: Gutman Library’s Study Room 101 seats six to eight people, includes a plasma screen for computer projection, and can be reserved by Jefferson students.
cards.source_title: Paul J. Gutman Library | Reserving Space
cards.access_notes: Current students, faculty, and staff reserve with a Jefferson-issued email; one reservation at a time for a four-hour window.

cards.title: Gutman’s Quiet-Zone Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Paul J. Gutman Library · East Falls
cards.notes: Reserve a second-floor study room for a small group that needs lower-noise surroundings; each room seats three to four people in the quiet zone.
cards.short_summary: Reservable small-group rooms inside Gutman’s quiet zone.
cards.evidence_claim: Gutman Library says its first- and second-floor study rooms seat three to four people and that the second-floor spaces are in a quiet zone.
cards.source_title: Paul J. Gutman Library | Reserving Space
cards.access_notes: Available to current Jefferson students, faculty, and staff through the self-service booking system for a four-hour window.

cards.title: Rena Rowan Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Paul J. Gutman Library · East Falls
cards.notes: Reserve the Rena Rowan Reading Room when a larger study group needs room to spread out; it seats up to 20 and can be booked for up to five hours.
cards.short_summary: A large-group reading room available for student study bookings.
cards.evidence_claim: Gutman Library states that students may book the Rena Rowan Reading Room for large group study; it seats up to 20 and is available up to five hours.
cards.source_title: Paul J. Gutman Library | Reserving Space
cards.access_notes: Primarily intended for faculty- or staff-led tutoring or instruction, but students may book it for large-group study.

cards.title: Gutman Ground-Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Paul J. Gutman Library · East Falls
cards.notes: Use Gutman’s ground-floor quiet-study area for individual work, choosing from the available quiet space and individual carrels across that floor.
cards.short_summary: Ground-floor quiet space with individual study carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson identifies quiet study space throughout Gutman Library’s ground floor, including individual study carrels.
cards.access_notes: Gutman’s posted schedule is Monday–Thursday 8am–2am, Friday 8am–9pm, Saturday 10am–5pm, and Sunday noon–2am.
